summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filing by AVAX One Technology Ltd. (formerly AgriFORCE Growing Systems) regarding amendments to existing debentures held by an institutional investor. The company agreed to increase principal amounts on three notes by roughly 10% each ($110k to $121k, $277,778 to $305,556, $550k to $605k) and raise the required cash/Bitcoin covenant from $100,000 to $3,500,000, in exchange for waiver of a negative covenant and release of claims. This is an ordinary debt modification, not a special-situation event. No M&A, restructuring, tender offer, or activist campaign is present. What to watch: continued compliance with the raised covenant.
